reading.action: Ascend the stair silently; try to see 'it' before it sees me (stealth + first-look read on floor 2)
reading.result: good — climbs unseen, achieves the goal (sees the threat first). Perceives: the flooded hall, cold/wet/dark, the broken-walkway ledge w/ brazier-stand + rope + loose slabs; across the water a heavy armored shape (Drowned Sentry) waist-deep, slow, barring the far stair, NOT yet aware of him. Half-senses the water itself is wrong/moving (Glut seed) without identifying it. Did NOT earn the tactical gate-reads (armor weakness, fire bane, swarm cohesion) — those need closer study, like the Ashling core.
